explanation.1_connectorContractChange: Phase 20B.2-A replaces the Dubins CSC connector to the anchor POSE (LSL/RSR/LSR/RSL) by the one-turn CS connector to the anchor POINT (S / LS / RS, sweep <= pi, terminal heading free, position-only weld at the level entry). Every winnerAccessConnectors entry therefore changes by construction (LSR -> LS on TABULAR / CUT_AND_FILL, RSR/RSL -> RS on WARPED-301 / IRREGULAR); connector pieces are exactly [ARC, STRAIGHT] on every selected access (0 pure-S, 0 terminal arcs), the post-turnout heading variation of the delivered straight is 0 within 1e-9 (unit test), and terminalHeadingMismatchDeg (access vs drift AXIS) is reported per level: TABULAR 72.7-77.8 deg, WARPED-301 61.0-89.8 deg (T-junction geometry, never gated).
explanation.2_tabularWinnerChange: TABULAR-REFERENCE / CUT_AND_FILL feasibleCount 2 -> 3 (SPIRAL-n1-CW-e+0-g0.120 newly FEASIBLE: 12/13 -> 13/13 accessible) and winner SPIRAL-n1-CW-e+0-g0.100 -> SPIRAL-n1-CW-e+0-g0.120 (total 3.8157 -> 3.4821; main ramp 4679 -> 3954 m). The steeper helix was previously excluded by ONE level whose CSC access failed; with the direct CS branch that level is served. Per-level access lengths drop from 52-98 m (CSC loops, mean |dP| 31.1 m) to 37.9-38.3 m (mean |dP| 8.1 m); plan separations 37.1-37.5 m (>= 30 m gate), pillars 14.4-15.0 m (>= 10 m gate, min 14.38 m — the 9.987 m borderline of the 20B.1-v2 CW winner is gone), pathToChordRatio 1.02-1.03, turnout arcs 11.8-13.7 m, straights 24.4-26.2 m.
explanation.3_warpedUnchangedWinner: WARPED_VEIN-301 / IRREGULAR keep SPIRAL-n1-CCW-e+0-g0.120 (total 4.1214 -> 4.0721 and 5.9287 -> 5.8795 from the shorter access development: 760.0 -> 544.1 m); accessible 14/14; per-level lengths 33.8-48.9 m, plan separations 30.3-45.8 m, pillars 10.9-16.5 m, pathToChordRatio 1.00-1.12, turnout arcs 7.2-26.2 m, straights 8.5-29.1 m. WARPED-307 stays NO_FEASIBLE_CANDIDATE (proven geometry); ACCESS-INFEASIBLE stays 0 by design.
explanation.4_geometryStressLoss: GEOMETRY-STRESS: SUCCESS (SWITCHBACK-k1-p+20-CCW-g0.100, 21/21) -> NO_FEASIBLE_CANDIDATE (feasible 0/68 normal AND 0 exhaustive; layout-v2-audit). Under CSC the alternating levels L02/L04/.../L10 of the k1 switchback were served ONLY by RSR/RSL loops (175.8 / 173.6 / 171.3 / 171.9 / 169.4 m accesses vs 62-73 m on the other levels): the second terminal arc bought the horizontal length that made the vertical drop meet g_max. With one-turn CS those levels have 0 valid connectors even ignoring junction spacing (B-5 starvationSuspected = False on every failing level): junctions above the level give a direct branch too short for the drop (GRADE_LIMIT, e.g. L02 s=1620: dz +9.6 m, H = 80 m, g = -0.1204), junctions at level elevation sit inside the hairpin (TURNOUT_NOT_STRAIGHT > 100 deg) or head away (CONNECTOR_UNAVAILABLE), and the LS candidates beyond the hairpin fail the rock-pillar gate. No threshold was adjusted to recover the case (directive 2.1); the loss is the documented rule-171 limitation — a switchback level turnout at the hairpin needs the Phase 20C straight-insert / hairpin-station family support — recorded in docs/roadmap.md.
explanation.5_normalVsExhaustive: layout-v2-audit: winnerNormal == winnerExhaustive on all 7 cases (TABULAR / CUT_AND_FILL 45 cheap / 12 shortlist / 3 normal / 14 exhaustive; WARPED-301 / IRREGULAR 39 / 12 / 3 / 10; STRESS 15 / 12 / 0 / 0; 307 44 / 12 / 0 / 0; ACCESS-INFEASIBLE 45 / 12 / 0 / 0). missedFamilies = [SWITCHBACK] on the four SUCCESS cases remains the documented bounded-shortlist limitation (rule 165).
explanation.6_selectionKey: Selection key is now (selection cost, length3d, junction chainage, connector sense S < LS < RS) — the terminal-sense tie-break of the CSC era is replaced by the connector-word rank; access_length_cost / LONG_ACCESS_COEF / all hard gates unchanged.
